item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 30/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a hot southwesterly airstream will also affect the region. With the southwesterly airstream becoming active and under the influence of the upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled and showers will be heavy at times over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Co-May will move across eastern China in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 31/07 (Thursday)
Wind: Southwest force 4, occasionally force 5 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers and a few squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier at first. Bright periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 27 - 31 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
